verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a collaboration and work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. The pack documents no native Asana whiteboard. The only whiteboard-adjacent evidence is third-party integrations (the Asana widget for Figma/FigJam and Canva embeds), which are other products' capabilities rather than Asana's own. Community mentions of 'boards' refer to task boards, not freeform whiteboards.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
